---
title: Publishing and withdrawal
---

Nothing reaches this library without a person approving it. Anything listed can be withdrawn
through the same reviewed path.

## Publishing

1. The author releases a version from an approved book commit.
2. The author opens a [listing request](https://github.com/cesarcastrocuba/handbooks-hub/issues/new?template=request-listing.yml) with the repository and release tag.
3. A catalog change is prepared. Published files are verified against the manifest and checksums.
4. A reviewer who did not prepare the change checks it.
5. The hub owner merges. The library is rebuilt and deployed automatically.

## Withdrawal

1. Anyone can open a [withdrawal request](https://github.com/cesarcastrocuba/handbooks-hub/issues/new?template=request-withdrawal.yml) with the book and reason.
2. If a release is defective or infringing, the entry is removed first so readers stop being sent to it.
3. If a corrected release exists, the catalog moves to it before the old one is removed.
4. The owner approves the change. Release files are deleted; the version tag stays as a record.

::: {.callout-note title="Why the owner gate?"}
Checksums prove that files are the ones that were built. They do not prove content was reviewed.
That decision stays with a person and is recorded.
:::
